verdict.rationale: The Entity Management API docs list an "api-alpha.sam.gov" endpoint alongside the API-key flow. That suggests a documented non-production environment, but the evidence never explicitly calls it a sandbox or test environment. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that alpha is a public sandbox/test environment, how to get alpha credentials or test data, confirmation that the full rail (keys, system accounts, extracts) can be exercised end to end there, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
